title: Lina Galore wins Drag Race Italia Season 3
summary: In the Grand Finale (IT-S03-E12), Lina Galore defeated Melissa Bianchini in the Lip Sync for the Crown to Paola & Chiara's "Furore", becoming Drag Race Italia's third Drag Superstar. La Sheeva and Silvana Della Magliana were eliminated from the final four without a lip sync.

title: Adriana Picasso: Italia Season 3's first Porkchop
summary: Adriana Picasso was the first contestant eliminated on Drag Race Italia season 3 (IT-S03-E01), losing the lip sync to "Pazzeska" against La Prada.

title: A double shantay to "Siamo donne"
summary: In IT-S03-E10, bottom two La Sheeva and Silvana Della Magliana both won their lip sync to Sabrina Salerno and Jo Squillo's "Siamo donne", and both were declared safe with no elimination.
